title: Chronicle Events File
description: Deterministic event triggers for the v1 scenario package contract. Map keys are injected as trigger ids.

condition_type.description: Predicates accepted by the event system (see condition_type_to_string).

args.description: Polymorphic string arguments. Count and meaning depend on type.

action_type.description: Action types currently accepted by the validator.

params.description: Action-specific named parameters as strings (e.g. npc_id, location_id, flag_id, value, item_id, text).

id.description: Optional; the loader injects the map key as id.

conditions.description: All conditions must be true (AND semantics) for the trigger to fire.

once.description: If true, the trigger is disabled after firing once.

fired.description: Runtime state persisted across saves. Authored data should leave this false.
